Start the drt MCP server (stdio transport).

Requires: pip install drt-core[mcp]

Add to Claude Desktop or Cursor:

```
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "drt": {
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": ["drt-core[mcp]", "mcp", "run"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Usage

```bash
drt mcp run [OPTIONS]
```
